prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: replacement user-facing Five Elements model — Earth element
Input images: Image 1 is the locked clay material, lighting, softness, camera, and finish reference only; do not include the oracle character
Primary request: create an unmistakable cute mountain sculpture for the Earth element: a compact mountain range with one tall rounded central peak and two smaller rounded side peaks, all rising together from one broad grounded stone base; add shallow hand-sculpted contour ridges that follow the mountain forms
Style/medium: premium handmade matte 3D polymer clay; softly rounded collectible designer-toy proportions; subtle fingerprints and sculpting irregularities; same softness and polish as Image 1
Composition/framing: one centered isolated mountain-range object, front three-quarter view, strong triangular silhouette readable at 64px, generous equal padding, no cropping
Lighting/mood: bright diffused studio daylight from upper left, soft neutral-lavender bounce; grounded, stable, protective
Color palette: warm terracotta base, muted ochre and sandy-clay peaks, pale cream highlight on the tallest peak, one subtle lilac reflected edge; earthy colors dominant
Scene/backdrop: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key green (#00FF00), edge to edge, for clean post-production cutout
Constraints: visibly a mountain range, not stacked blobs; exactly three connected peaks on one stone base; no character, face, eyes, text, Chinese characters, symbols, gold stone, plants, snow, landscape scenery, frame, watermark, cast shadow, background texture, or green reflection
Avoid: pastry or cake appearance, horizontal piled cushions, sharp realistic geology, flat icon, glossy plastic, volcano, floating rocks, extra objects, magenta background
